components.description: One semester of parental leave at the same salary and benefits, relieving teaching, research and governance, for a full-time tenured or tenure-track faculty member who becomes a parent by birth or adoption and certifies being the primary caregiver; only one of two eligible spouses or partners.
components.mechanism_note: A dedicated parental leave paid by the university at the salary the member would otherwise have received.
components.faculty_group_note: full-time faculty member who is tenured or tenure-track (Danforth Campus Policy on Parental Leave for Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty)
components.eligible_parent_wording: a full-time faculty member ... or that faculty member’s spouse or domestic partner, becomes the parent of a child, either by childbirth or by placement of a child for adoption
components.caregiver_condition_wording: The agreement shall include a certification by the faculty member that the purpose of the leave will be to serve as the primary caregiver for that child during the period of leave or to recapture time spent as the primary caregiver during the preceding summer.
components.dual_employee_rule: either one, but not both, may take the leave (if both spouses or partners are eligible); the other may elect a tenure-clock pause (component c4)
components.entitlement_note: 'shall, upon written request ... be entitled': the text grants the leave; the request and written agreement cover the arrangements (V2; schema: 'shall be granted upon request' is guaranteed_on_request).
components.duration_note: One semester; each semester runs from the first day of classes to the last day of classes.
components.pay_fraction: the same salary and benefits that he or she would have received that semester if not on leave
components.relief_note: Teaching, research and scholarship, and all governance including committee work are relieved; advising and clinical duties are not named (R4b). A member who would have taught more than half the annual load in the leave semester may be required to teach one additional course in another semester.
components.return_obligation: may be required to teach one additional course in another semester, where the leave semester would otherwise have carried more than half of the normal annual teaching load
components.time_window: during the semester in which the child is born or placed for adoption, or any subsequent semester that begins no later than six months after the birth or adoption
components.notice: written request to the department chair or dean, as soon as reasonably possible after the need becomes known; written agreement

Danforth Campus Policy on Parental Leave for Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty
eligible_parent: When a full-time faculty member who is tenured or tenure-track, or that faculty member’s spouse or domestic partner, becomes the parent of a child, either by childbirth or by placement of a child for adoption
caregiver_condition: The agreement shall include a certification by the faculty member that the purpose of the leave will be to serve as the primary caregiver for that child during the period of leave or to recapture time spent as the primary caregiver during the preceding summer.
entitlement: the faculty member shall, upon written request to his or her department chair or dean, be entitled to a parental leave of one semester as described in section 3
duration: the faculty member shall, upon written request to his or her department chair or dean, be entitled to a parental leave of one semester as described in section 3
For purposes of this section, each semester shall run from the first day of classes to the last day of classes.
pay_fraction: A faculty member who takes parental leave under this policy shall receive the same salary and benefits that he or she would have received that semester if not on leave
relief: The faculty member shall be relieved of the obligation to teach during the semester in which the leave is taken.
The faculty member shall be relieved of research and scholarship expectations for one semester.
The faculty member shall be relieved of all faculty governance responsibilities, including committee work, for one semester.
time_window: At the option of the faculty member, the parental leave provided by this policy may be taken during the semester in which the child is born or placed for adoption, or during any subsequent semester that begins no later than six months after the birth or adoption.
dual_employee_rule: If a faculty member and his or her spouse or domestic partner would otherwise both be eligible for parental leave under this policy, either one, but not both, may take the leave provided in section 3.
return_obligation: If the semester during which a leave is taken is one in which the faculty member would otherwise have taught more than half of his or her normal annual teaching load, the faculty member may be required to teach one additional course in another semester to be agreed upon by the faculty member and his or her department chair or dean.

components.description: Federal Family and Medical Leave Act leave for the birth or placement of a child, 12 workweeks unpaid; the policy intends the parental leave to count as FMLA leave where it qualifies.

notes: Reference date 2018-02-26. 2018_04_parental_leave_policy_pdf_11-2014 is the print PDF of the parental-leave policy.

Governing document: the Danforth Campus Policy on Parental Leave for Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty (effective July 1, 1999), capture 2018-02-15, in force on the reference date. The Danforth Campus is read as the main campus (V3): the Tenure Policy distinguishes the School of Medicine and the Danforth Campus, and the site lists Arts & Sciences and Engineering among the schools; faculty_scope 'Danforth Campus' records the policy's own scope, which excludes the Medical Campus.

Section VI: parental leave is 'in addition to any leave granted because of medical incapacitation'. No medical-leave or sick-leave policy is saved, so no component is coded for it; flagged cross_reference_not_saved on c1. If saved, the medical leave would be a birth-parent component with c1 consecutive_after it (S1a-like 'in addition').
Tenure Policy IV.B.2 lets each school adopt policies suspending the tenure clock and partially reassigning duties for family responsibilities; no school policy is saved (flag on c6).

Section VII (FMLA): the leave is intended to count as FMLA leave; the chair or dean may require the paid parental leave to be substituted during designated FMLA leave. FMLA coded from the saved statute (29 U.S.C. 2611, 2612), concurrent_with the parental leave (S1).

Faculty Information Handbook leaves page: capture 2017-07-05, undated (©2017), the nearest capture; read as in force but flagged version_uncertain. Its factors (scholarly promise, research, book) suggest a research leave, but the purposes are an open list ('etc.'), so coded general_purpose (U1).
Calendar: semesters stated without length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: parental leave 1 semester at full salary (c1; FMLA 12 workweeks c2 concurrent from its start) -> discretionary extension by chair or dean, length unstated (c5). Leave for medical incapacitation would precede c1 ('in addition'), but its policy is not saved. Tenure clock: c3.

Chain, non-birth parent: the same: parental leave 1 semester (c1, primary caregiver certification; FMLA c2 concurrent) -> extension (c5). If both parents are eligible faculty, only one takes c1; the other may pause the tenure clock (c4).
